texts.preamble: D.Sekar vs The Commissioner on 13 October, 2023 Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan W.P.(MD)No. Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 13.10.2023 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan W.P.(MD)No.24218 of 2023 And W.M.P.(MD)Nos.20396 & 20397 of 2023 D.Sekar ... Petitioner Vs. 1. The Commissioner, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Dms Campus, 5th Floor, No.359, Anna Salai, Tenampet, Chennai 600 006. 2. The Designated Officer, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Food Safety Wing, Madurai District. 3. Food Safety Officer, Madurai Corporation, Madurai. 4. The Inspector of Police, C-2, Police Station (Subramaniapuram police station), Madurai. ... Respondents Prayer: Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o issue a Writ of Certiorari, calling for the entire records from the second respo impugned notice No.R.No.1894/FSD/2023 dated 26.09.2023 and quash the same. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 1/5 W.P.(Md) D.Sekar vs The Commissioner on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144884171/ 1 For Petitioner : Mr.R.Ramasamy (*)For R-1 to R-3 : Mr.V.Nirmal Kumar, Government Advocate. For R-4 : Mr.A.Albert James, Government Advocate.
